# Image editing and upscaling

**Edit, don't reroll: inpaint, outpaint, swap backgrounds, relight, fix hands and upscale, with a provenance chain per edit.**

Fixes and extends AI images by editing instead of regenerating — inpainting a region, outpainting to a new aspect, background swaps, relighting, face and hand fixes, text and logo removal, and upscaling for print or 4K — with the edit-capable models in @useclaudia/media (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, Nano Banana 2.1 and Pro, FLUX Kontext, FLUX.2, Seedream, Runway Aleph 2 for video), a crop-edit-composite method for exact regions, local upscalers, and a provenance chain that survives every edit. Use when an image is mostly right but one part is wrong, when a still must be widened or cut down for another format, when a background, light or outfit detail needs to change, when an image needs more pixels, or when someone asks "can you fix this instead of making a new one".

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 5–15 min per image | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Decide: edit or regenerate
2. Pick the model for the job
3. Write the edit as preserve + one change
4. Crop, edit, composite exact regions
5. Outpaint by padding first
6. Swap background, then relight
7. Upscale only as far as needed
8. Log the chain and label the result

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
